summary_md: **RobotNurse ([@robotnurseio](https://x.com/robotnurseio/status/2115439167664431460))** recounts two identical Mac Studios prefilling at 373.7 vs 118.2 tok/s because one chip was stuck near a third of its clock while power telemetry reported 0 mW; the linked post argues for benchmarking the hardware before the software.

referenced_urls.title: Benchmark the Hardware Before You Benchmark the Software

relevance: A debugging lesson for anyone benchmarking local inference rigs.
